installCommand: if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain none; fi; [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/env" ] && . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && rustup default stable && rustc --version
